1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable letter spacing and ample line height in headings, body text, and labels.

2.why: No italics, all-caps, or dense paragraphs appear; every instruction is a short plain sentence or label.

3.why: Centered card layouts with generous whitespace and large tap targets remain legible and uncluttered even when viewed at mobile widths.

4.why: Instructions consist of one-sentence directives such as “Use this manual Base32 secret in an authenticator app” written in everyday language.

5.why: Email and phone fields contain example values and the six-digit test OTP is displayed nearby, though the code input itself lacks a placeholder.

6.why: No screen presents more than a couple of short sentences before the user can act; long text blocks are entirely absent.

7.why: The Base32 secret and all recovery codes are rendered as ordinary selectable text that can be copied, even though no dedicated copy button is provided.

8.why: Only a manual Base32 string is offered; no QR code or other scannable alternative appears on any authenticator setup screen.

9.why: Standard email and telephone inputs are present and could accept autofill, yet no explicit autocomplete attributes, password-manager hooks, or OTP autofill cues are visible.

10.why: Each step is announced by a bold heading and the single primary action is a high-contrast blue button that stands out clearly.

11.why: Every screen asks for exactly one main action (sign-in, confirm, create secret, verify, generate codes, etc.) with secondary options visually de-emphasized.

12.why: After each action the UI advances to a new titled screen and appends a plain-language log entry describing what occurred and the resulting state.

13.why: A “Regenerate codes” button and a “View recovery codes” option let the user re-display or replace codes without any lock-out or penalty.

14.why: No error states or error messages are shown in any of the thirteen screenshots, so the claim that errors are helpful and non-blaming cannot be confirmed.

15.why: No countdown timers, session expiry warnings, or input time limits appear on any step of the flow.
